lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，我要你尝尝我的酸液！

lines.en: My hem sweeps by and the ground smokes.

lines.zh: 我的酸液会腐蚀你的皮肤！
lines.en: My acid will eat through your skin!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的毒液，你一定会想死！
lines.en: Taste my venom, you'll wish you were dead!

lines.zh: 我身上的酸液是致命的！
lines.en: The acid on me is deadly!

lines.zh: 快逃跑，否则你会变成一堆烂肉！
lines.en: Run or you'll turn into a pile of mush!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我的酸液无处不在！
lines.en: You can't escape, my acid is everywhere!

lines.zh: 尝尝我的酸液，你会痛苦的！
我的酸液会腐蚀你的骨骼！
lines.en: My acid will corrode your bones!

lines.zh: 别想活过今天，我的酸液会要了你的命！
lines.en: You won't make it through today, my acid will get you!

lines.zh: 佝偻着背，酸液沿指缝滴
lines.en: Hunched over, acid dripping from her fingers.
Where she steps, grass turns black.

lines.zh: 我在这里守护我的巢穴！
我的酸液滴落，腐蚀一切！

lines.en: Look at me, you'll be scared!

lines.zh: 我的眼睛可以看到你的一举一动！
lines.en: My eyes see your every move!

lines.zh: 我的酸液可以让你无法动弹！
我的存在会让这个地方变得有毒！
我的巢穴充满了腐蚀性的酸液！
lines.en: My nest is full of corrosive acid!

lines.zh: 我的声音让你感到恐惧！
我的巢穴是唯一的安全之处！
lines.en: My lair is the only safe place!

lines.zh: 我的酸液会让一切都化为灰烬！
lines.en: My acid turns all to ash!
Look at me, you'll be scared!

lines.zh: 我的酸液会腐蚀你的心脏！
lines.en: My acid will eat your heart!

lines.zh: 你最好祈祷我不发现你！
lines.en: You'd better pray I don't find you!

lines.zh: 我的酸液可以瞬间杀死你！
lines.en: My acid will kill you instantly!

lines.zh: 你离我近点，我要吞噬你！
我的酸液会带你去地狱！
lines.en: My acid will take you to hell!

lines.zh: 粘稠酸液滴落，腐蚀一切。
尝尝我的毒液，你会后悔的。
lines.en: Taste my venom, you’ll regret it.
You don’t want to get close to me.

lines.zh: 我有更多酸液可以分享。
lines.en: I have more acid to share.

lines.zh: 快离开，否则你会变成酸水。
lines.en: Get away before you turn into acid.

lines.zh: 我的毒液能让你变得更弱。
别看我的眼睛，会腐蚀你的视线。
lines.en: Don’t look at my eyes, they’ll corrode your sight.

lines.zh: 品尝我的酸液，你将忘却一切。
lines.en: Taste my acid and forget everything.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，必须被清除。
lines.en: You’re in my way, you must be cleared.
Touch me, and you’ll regret it.

lines.zh: 躲开我，否则你会被腐蚀。
lines.en: Stay away from me, or you’ll be corroded.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，否则你会受伤。
lines.en: Don’t come closer, or you’ll be hurt.

lines.zh: 你阻碍了我的路，必须消失。
lines.en: You’re blocking my path, you must vanish.

lines.zh: 你挡了我的去路，必须被干掉。
lines.en: You’re blocking my path, you must be killed.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我感到威胁。
lines.en: Your existence is a threat to me.
We need a partner to reproduce.

lines.zh: 我们的酸液能让后代更强。
lines.en: Our acid makes our offspring stronger.
We seek our kind to reproduce.
This filthy pearl is mine to brew with.
This dirty pearl is not yours.

lines.zh: 你的末影珍珠，我的晚餐！
找到你了，准备迎接酸液吧！
猎物就在眼前，享受酸液吧！
你的末影珍珠，我的新玩具！
酸液是我的武器，你逃不掉！

lines.en: Nightmare's first floor; you should not be here.
Twenty-five health lasts a long while.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子泡在酸里
lines.en: I soak your shadow in acid.
You stepped in my acid pool.

lines.zh: 伸手一指，酸液已经出发
lines.en: She points; the acid is already on its way.
Do not run yet; let a layer of skin rot first.

lines.zh: 酸液准备好了，瞄准射击！

lines.en: Her palm lifts; acid beads into a sphere.

lines.zh: 她舔了舔指尖，笑得很难看
lines.en: She licks a fingertip and grins awfully.

lines.zh: 抛物线算好，专往脸上泼
lines.en: The arc is solved; it aims for your face.

lines.zh: 一至四点酸液，够你回味
lines.en: One to four points of acid, enough to remember.

lines.zh: 她退半步，好让酸液铺开
lines.en: She steps back so the acid can spread.
Your armor will not stop a liquid.
She counts the gaps in your gear.
A flick of the wrist fans the acid out.

lines.zh: 她等你张嘴，然后泼进去
lines.en: She waits for you to open your mouth.

lines.zh: 酸雾升起，视野开始模糊
lines.en: Acid mist rises; your sight blurs.
This is the taste of death!
Five fingers rake, nails wet with acid.

lines.zh: 她把整瓶酸液砸在你身上
lines.en: She smashes a whole flask onto you.
Acid runs down inside your collar.
She slaps a palm on your shoulder.
A rotting hand breaks your skin.
She smiles as you start to smoke.
She spits a mouthful of acid in your face.

lines.zh: 她扯住你的袖子，酸液渗进
lines.en: She grabs your sleeve; acid soaks through.
Her cane swings, acid dripping from its tip.
She hugs you, and you both corrode.
Nightmare's first floor; the acid pool bubbles.
An old woman crawls out of the rotting soil.

lines.zh: 酸液洒了，梦魇的石头也疼。
lines.en: My acid spills, and even nightmare stone stings.
An arrow popped my poison blister.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击破坏了我的皮肤！
